Incident INC-TEST-001: Payment API Database Connection Timeout
    Service: Payment API
    Error: DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
    Recent Change: Database configuration update
    
    Failed Attempts:
    - Restart service: FAILED (Did not release hanging connections)
    - Increase request timeout: FAILED (Requests continued hanging until connection pool exhausted)
    
    Successful Fix:
    - Roll back database configuration: SUCCESSFUL
    
    Root Cause: Incorrect database connection pool configuration deployed in v2.4.1.
    Lesson Learned: For DB connection timeout spikes following config deployment, restarting the service and increasing request timeout do NOT work. Rollback config immediately.

Incident Record: INC-001 - Payment API DB Connection Timeout Spike
Service: Payment API
Environment: Production
Error Code: DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
Symptoms: Payment API endpoints return HTTP 504. Database connection pool reaches 100% saturation within 5 minutes of high traffic.
Recent Changes: Database pool configuration update deployed 30 mins prior to incident.

Troubleshooting Actions Attempted:
- Restart service container: FAILED (Hung connection sockets remained open in TCP CLOSE_WAIT state)
- Increase request timeout limit to 30s: FAILED (Worsened database pool exhaustion as connections were held open longer)

Final Resolution:
- Successful Action: Roll back database pool configuration update v2.4.1
- Confirmed Root Cause: Incorrect max_connections parameter in database configuration update v2.4.1 causing connection pool deadlocks

Organizational Lessons Learned:
- Restarting service does NOT release hanging TCP connection sockets during pool deadlocks
- Increasing request timeouts exacerbates connection pool saturation
- When DB timeouts follow a config update, rollback configuration before attempting application workarounds

metadata.root_cause: Incorrect max_connections parameter in database configuration update v2.4.1 causing connection pool deadlocks
metadata.successful_fix: Roll back database pool configuration update v2.4.1

Incident Record: INC-002 - Payment API Database Timeout Spike
Service: Payment API
Environment: Production
Error Code: DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
Symptoms: API requests timing out after 30 seconds. Connection pool exhaustion observed.
Recent Changes: New connection-pool library version 3.1.0 deployed 20 minutes ago.

Troubleshooting Actions Attempted:
- Increase pool acquire timeout to 45s: FAILED (Connections remained blocked; pool size was mismatched with database server limit)

Final Resolution:
- Successful Action: Configure connection pool max_size=50 in library 3.1.0 configuration
- Confirmed Root Cause: Default pool size in connection-pool v3.1.0 library defaulted to 500 while Postgres server max_connections was set to 100

Organizational Lessons Learned:
- Upgrade of connection-pool v3.1.0 resets default max pool limit to 500
- Always align application connection pool limits with DB server limits prior to deployment

metadata.root_cause: Default pool size in connection-pool v3.1.0 library defaulted to 500 while Postgres server max_connections was set to 100
metadata.successful_fix: Configure connection pool max_size=50 in library 3.1.0 configuration

Incident Record: INC-005 - [PRODUCTION AUDIT] Ledger timeout baseline
Service: Audit Ledger Service
Environment: Production
Error Code: LEDGER_WRITE_TIMEOUT
Symptoms: Ledger writes time out while the queue backs up and database connections saturate.
Recent Changes: Routine traffic increase; no deployment or configuration change reported.

Troubleshooting Actions Attempted:
- Restart worker: FAILED (Queue and connection saturation persisted.)

Final Resolution:
- Successful Action: Restore ledger writer concurrency to 24 workers
- Confirmed Root Cause: Worker concurrency exceeded the database connection budget, exhausting available connections.

Organizational Lessons Learned:
- Keep ledger writer concurrency within the database connection budget.
- Restarting workers does not resolve a concurrency limit mismatch.

metadata.root_cause: Worker concurrency exceeded the database connection budget, exhausting available connections.
metadata.successful_fix: Restore ledger writer concurrency to 24 workers
